title: UE initiated transport of user data via the control plane

entities.name: UE initiated transport of user data via the control plane
entities.description: Procedure for UE to send user data via NAS control plane. Initiated when UE receives request to transfer user data via control plane.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT
entities.description: ESM message used to transport user data via control plane. Contains user data in User data container IE.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to carry ESM DATA TRANSPORT when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: User data container
entities.description: IE containing the user data to be transported. Length should not exceed link MTU size.

entities.name: Release assistance indication
entities.description: Optional IE indicating whether further data transmission is expected after current uplink data transfer.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state where NAS signalling connection is established.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: UE state where no NAS signalling connection is established.

entities.name: No further uplink or downlink data expected
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate data exchanges complete with current UL data transfer.

entities.name: Only single downlink data expected
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate data exchanges complete with next downlink data transmission.

entities.name: MME forwards user data to PDN connection
entities.description: MME identifies PDN connection based on EPS bearer identity and forwards User data container contents.

entities.name: Initiate NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: ESM layer indicates to EMM layer to initiate release of NAS signalling connection when release assistance indication is present.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending ESM DATA TRANSPORT message
Procedure can be initiated when UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode
Procedure can be initiated when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode using CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
Message contains User data container IE with user data
Message may optionally contain Release assistance indication IE
IE value can indicate no further uplink or downlink data expected
IE value can indicate only single downlink data expected
Condition triggers immediate NAS signalling connection release
Condition triggers NAS signalling connection release after next downlink data delivery
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message includes ESM DATA TRANSPORT message when UE is in EMM-IDLE
